summary: Profile management and session invalidation features tested successfully. All 7 features verified: 1) Profile Settings button visible in sidebar, 2) Profile modal opens with user info, 3) Wrong password shows error, 4) Correct password allows profile update, 5) Auto logout after profile update, 6) Session check endpoint works, 7) Admin deletion creates session invalidation.

issues: Minor: Missing aria-describedby for DialogContent (console warning, not a functional issue)

passed_tests: Profile Settings button ('Profil Ayarları') visible in sidebar
Profile modal opens when clicking Profile Settings button
User info (name: Onur Ertaş, username: onurertas) displayed in modal
Username input field exists and pre-filled with current username
New password input field exists with placeholder
Confirm password field appears when new password is entered
Current password field (required) exists with orange highlight
Warning note about relogin requirement displayed
Wrong current password shows error toast 'Mevcut şifre yanlış'
Profile update with correct password succeeds
Auto logout triggered after profile update
Redirect to login page after profile update
Toast message 'Bilgileriniz değişti. Yeniden giriş yapmanız gerekiyor.' shown
Session check endpoint returns valid=true for existing user
Session check endpoint returns valid=false, reason=user_deleted for non-existent user
Profile update with wrong password returns 401
Profile update with no changes returns 400
Profile update with existing username returns 400
Admin deletion creates session invalidation record
Session check returns valid=false after admin deletion
Clear session invalidation endpoint works
critical_code_review_comments: Profile update endpoint correctly validates current password before allowing changes
Session invalidation is properly created when admin is deleted or profile is updated
useSessionCheck hook checks backend every 30 seconds for session validity
Login page clears invalidation record after successful login
Frontend properly handles requires_relogin response and redirects to login
seed_data_creation: Test admin 'testdeleteadmin' created and deleted during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Profile management features fully implemented and tested: 1) Profile Settings button in sidebar opens modal, 2) Modal shows current user info and allows username/password change, 3) Current password verification required for all changes, 4) Session invalidation system works - when profile is updated or admin is deleted, their session is invalidated, 5) useSessionCheck hook polls backend every 30 seconds to check session validity, 6) Auto logout works when session is invalidated.

profile_settings_button.details: Button labeled 'Profil Ayarları' visible in sidebar, opens profile modal on click

profile_modal.details: Modal displays user info (name, username), has fields for new username, new password, confirm password, and required current password

wrong_password_error.details: Error toast 'Mevcut şifre yanlış' shown when wrong current password is entered

profile_update.details: Profile update succeeds with correct current password, returns requires_relogin=true

auto_logout.details: User is automatically logged out and redirected to login page after profile update

admin_delete_invalidation.details: When admin is deleted, session invalidation record is created, delete response includes invalidated_user_id
